rv.q: Soon an old lady appears, adjusting her dress, with a silly party hat on her head, and sits at the kitchen table where she will remain for most of the 70 minutes, just stirring things up as mayhem explodes around her. She is Eileen, celebrating her 90th birthday.
Karis Kelly’s family drama of inherited trauma, which won the Women’s Prize for Playwriting in 2022, shows impressive potential
Great performances from the four actors in this darkly comic drama exploring the interplay and acrimony between generations.
